text.facebook: 56% of pet owners are worried about affording vet bills, says the RSPCA, and 1 in 10 routinely use AI for pet advice. PDSA's latest report found a third of dog owners walk their dog for 30 minutes or less a day. My tip: check paws and coat after every walk, and if something's not right, ring the vet rather than asking a chatbot. https://www.foresthounds.co.uk/blog/vet-bills-and-prevention
